Categories: EDA, yieldWerx

Daniel is joined by Aftkhar Aslam, Co-Founder and CEO/CTO of yieldWerx. Aftkhar brings over 30 years of leadership in semiconductor manufacturing, yield engineering, and enterprise digital transformation. He previously held senior leadership roles at Texas Instruments and is a patented inventor. He has led yield optimization for industry leaders including Intel, Qualcomm, and Microsoft, and continues to focus on enabling next-generation AI, photonics, and advanced packaging ecosystems through data intelligence.
Daniel explores how yieldWerx has evolved to effectively address many growing data analytics challenges with Aftkhar. In this informative and far-reaching discussion, Aftkhar discusses how yieldWerx provides comprehensive solutions to facilitate trends such as advanced packaging, silicon photonics, and emerging quantum technologies. Daniel also explores the impact of AI and the new yieldWerx IQ™ system with Aftkhar.
